notes.title: Have you tried our second game, ‘The Dark Queen of Mortholme’?
notes.content:
[h3]Bladewings and Goblins,[/h3][p][/p][p]The past month has been an absolutely crazy one.[/p][p][i]Mainly because we thought it would be a good idea to release two games in the same month![/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587610/The_Dark_Queen_of_Mortholme/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228490/Atomic_Owl/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][i]Look at these two! 

[/i][b]Also, yes, there's a pretty steep bundle available where you can get both of these on the cheap if you get the bundle.[/b][/p][p]
The Dark Queen of Mortholme is our studio's first published indie game. Initially, we approached the developer, Mosu, to see if they would be interested in bringing [i]The Dark Queen of Mortholme[/i] to Steam, and after agreeing, we got to work on not only bringing it to Steam, but also adding Steam Achievements, full controller support, and are currently working on Steam Trading Cards and workshop support for Mortholme. [/p][p][/p][p]As far as our first experiment goes with publishing indie games, we're really happy with how it went for Mortholme. Yes, the game is short, but it packs a big punch. [/p][p][/p][h3][i]Make sure you give it a playthrough and support more titles from us and Mosu!

Follow us on [/i][url="https://x.com/monstertheaterx"]Twitter[/url][i] and join the [/i][url="https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3"]Discord[/url]
[/h3][p][i]P.S. Has anyone found the Mortholme plushies easter egg in Atomic Owl?[/i][/p]

notes.title: Atomic Owl v1.1.9 Patch [Major Gameplay Improvements]
notes.content:
[p align="start"][b]Hello Bladewings![/b][/p][p align="start"]
Thank you for taking the time to not only play Atomic Owl but also provide feedback and tell us what you're loving (and not loving) about the game.
[/p][p align="start"][b]Here's what we fixed this time![/b] [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Version 1.1.9 // Major Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]We've added tutorials![/b] One of the largest pieces of feedback was that players weren't really aware of what did what, and we even had a player beat the game without knowing you could switch weapons! To remedy this, there are now multiple tutorial screens that showcase what each mechanic in Atomic Owl's function is. [/p][/*][*][p]We've seen the reports -- the whip was too strong and the broadsword was too weak. We remedied this by increasing the base damage of the Broadsword while lowering how much damage the whip does to incentivize weapon experimentation. [/p][/*][*][p]Beyond this, we adjusted the damage of the Flame and Poison Wing Remnants so that they do the same amount of damage, but stacked differently on enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]We also accounted for some of the visual issues with lighting and have toned down how intense some of the neon lights are in the game to make it easier on player's eyes. [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Version 1.1.9 // Minor Fixes and Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Permanent Upgrade campfire controller glyphs are now uniform with the rest of the game. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Trigger button that appears when activating the Void Crow transformation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some cloud visibility issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with navigation in the Death Gauntlet levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Mezameta sword appears when emerging from the tutorial Virtual Nest. [/p][/*][*][p]Goliam was missing in the 2nd half of the game! He is now back in all of his glory. [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Version 1.1.9 // Game Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the cost of 'Second Wind' in the Twilight Perch.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some fun NPC dialogues throughout the game! [/p][/*][*][p]Weapon glow color pertaining to shields is now correct.[/p][/*][*][p]Added one more little secret easter egg.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]We hope you enjoy playing Atomic Owl!![/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Follow us here:[/p][p][url="https://monstertheater.carrd.co/"]https://monstertheater.carrd.co/[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Join the Discord:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3"]https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3[/url][/p]

notes.title: Thank you for a great launch. Don't forget to review Atomic Owl on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Friends and players,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]It's been about...96 hours since Atomic Owl has arrived on Steam. Give or take? It's been amazing to see you all finally play the game. [/p][p][b]
We're also really happy that everyone seems to enjoy it! A million thank yous for a positive rating![/b] [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/e3cda94cd382f29a5357a44a3439c9921a78352f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]However, we need your help![/b] 
[/p][p]With any new indie game, a product lives and dies by its Steam reviews. Our particular challenge with this launch is that we gave away over 1500 Steam codes to backers, friends, family, and creators. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Why is this bad?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Well, Steam likes to surface games to new players and determine success based on Steam reviews that were [b]purchased directly from the store[/b], NOT given out by keys! So as a friendly reminder.
[/p][p][b]If you're on the fence about purchasing a Steam copy of Atomic Owl for yourself or for a friend, please do so and leave a review on Steam!
[/b][/p][p][b]Steam page: [/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228490/Atomic_Owl/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i]It will not only help us algorithmically, but also help show Steam that we have people willing to support the game outside of crowdfunding avenues! [/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/58f505dc21cfd35a57b035cb65ad0a186493b5e7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]That being said, it's International Owl Awareness Day![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Please remember to leave your community's friendly owls in peace, respect their space, and if you bird watch -- please do it from afar. [/p][p][/p][p]Be kind to our winged wizards of the sky.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/5d9556a519a2763b0016567bb3bbb7f50a161c2c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]your friend,[/p][p]eldar[/p]

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.1 [Player Feedback Update + Patch Notes]
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello Bladewings![/b][/p][p]
Thank you for taking the time to not only play Atomic Owl but also provide feedback and tell us what you're loving (and not loving) about the game. [/p][p]Today, just 24 hours after launch, we wanted to make sure we push through an update that reaches the vision behind what we had in mind for the game. 

That being said, we have heard many reports that the game was too hard in the beginning and too easy in the end. We remedied this by balancing health between the start of the game and the end. Now, when you play as Character #2, you will not carry over health upgrades from the first character, and you will lose EXP and Wing Remnants acquired with that character. 

[b]We heard the game was "too slow", so we doubled the speed![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/bb0468308cf94173a9132fbdc976342393a89b08.gif"][/img][/p][p]There was an issue where the game would not pause during the STATUS screen. We fixed this by pausing the game and enabling transparency to the menu itself. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/c41fc5ff9cab36927d336f61164d8ce276f73191.gif"][/img][/p][p]We also saw confusion from players regarding Wing Remnant upgrades. We've added a text line under each pickup that explains what happens when you get two Wing Remnants. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/b65d3f04090794d208284a1ec832bd8ae2847713.png"][/img][/p][p]
There are lots of other changes, so let's dive in! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Version 1.1 // Major Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]There was an issue where the first boss, Goliam, would enter his ball state and bounce out of bounds. This has been fixed. [/p][/*][*][p]The Void Crow transformation has been greatly balanced and patched. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Version 1.1 // Minor Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]On certain aspect ratios, the door at the bottom of the Bladewing Dusk level would be obscured. [/p][/*][*][p]Incorporated code side failsafes to ensure that players unlock the final boss-related Steam achievement. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Yutameta binary text overlapping. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Version 1.1 // Game Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Speed is now retained when jumping during a sprint state. [/p][/*][*][p]Transparency on the Status Menu, the game pauses on this menu now. [/p][/*][*][p]We gave Goliam and the second Omega Wing boss more health. [/p][/*][*][p]Reset character 2's progression and stats to ensure fair play in the second half of the game. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a little jingle to activate Save Terminals. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved Lightning Tengu miniboss logic and behavior, and made him immune to the Lightning Stun Wing Remnant. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved movement logic so that you can now dash using any direction based on input, not where the character sprite is facing. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage dealt by the Death Gauntlet when it grabs you. Also gave it a little 'Bone Crunch' SFX when grabbing Hidalgo. It's brutal. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed an NPC that made you feel bad for exploring. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]We hope you enjoy playing Atomic Owl!![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Follow us here: [url="https://monstertheater.carrd.co/"]https://monstertheater.carrd.co/[/url][/p][p]Join the Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3"]https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3[/url][/p]

notes.title: The Atomic Owl demo is OUT!
notes.content:
[b]Bladewings, it's time for you to play Atomic Owl. 

Demo page: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3159870/Atomic_Owl_Demo/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3159870/Atomic_Owl_Demo/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/19e08882f55d8bccc51a3b54cca1fd60bd2bbc66.png[/img]

Since our successful Kickstarter launch this past spring, we’ve been dedicated to making our debut title's demo as polished, bug-free, and enjoyable as possible. Last week, early Kickstarter backers at the Bladewing tier and above downloaded the demo and played it through the weekend. 

But today, our game's demo is available to everyone as part of Steam Next Fest.

We've already had a handful of content creators playing as well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/f1057e299d579fed8c107313643de19e79b57780.png[/img]

Let's talk about the demo a little bit! 

Atomic Owl is a neo-roguelite fusion sidescrolling platformer, inspired by games like Celeste, Dead Cells, MegaMan X, Hollow Knight, and more. However, we've recently made some interesting changes to the combat. Rather than the old design approach of hitting enemies repeatedly until they die, we've implemented a new way to engage enemies that we think you'll find very interesting and rewarding--a time stop + chain method of dispatching enemies, similar to games like Katana Zero, but with our spin. Easy for new players, but actively rewarding for high-level players and those who want to be stylish! 

The demo showcases a fair bit of story from the main game as well, but you are free to skip any dialogue and get straight into the action if you choose. The demo is also fairly short, roughly 20 - 30 minutes if you take your time. We wanted to get our most polished levels out but also give you a taste of what you can expect when we launch next year, but not give too much away.  

Demo Specifics:

• Quick 500 MB Download 
• Full Xbox/PS4/PS5/Keyboard Support 
• Full Steam API Integration 
• Playable on Steam Deck, but not completely optimized. If you choose to play it on Steam Deck, you will see bugs in the UI.
• Widescreen is supported, but you may see some letterboxing 

[b]We look forward to your feedback. [/b]

Want to talk about the demo on socials or in our Discord?

Join the party here: [url=https://monstertheater.carrd.co/ ]https://monstertheater.carrd.co/ [/url]

Haven't wishlisted the full game yet?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228490/Atomic_Owl/?beta=0 

The full game will be released in 2025 on Steam, GOG, Playstation 5 (Digital and Physical), Nintendo Switch (Digital and Physical), and Xbox Series X/S (Digital Only)

Atomic Owl is published by EastAsiaSoft, publishers of games like Cursed Castilla EX and Habroxia. 

Thank you for being a part of the Monster Theater story!

notes.title: Kickstarter Update (159% funded!) + Patreon Announcement!
notes.content:
[b]Atomic Owl's Kickstarter ended last week[/b]-- and while it was a really busy few days getting everything for pledge fulfillment, we saw a huge amount of support that reminds us why we are making this indie. It's for you. 

All 1,000 of you backers, that is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/2c1d769d668f844069c15bbed634909a96feaa3b.png[/img]

Let's Talk Rewards 🎁

So, we are moving on to delivering the game's soundtrack to all backers who have opted for the digital OST. 

This will be delivered right here via Steam code the week of May 15th, be on the lookout for it! 

If you're a Kickstarter backer, you should receive a survey asking for important information depending on which tier you backed. 

• All backers will have their name in the credits of Atomic Owl -- please indicate whichever name you'd like to use when replying to the survey. 
• We will also ask for a good shipping address -- if this changes at any point in the future, please let us know! 
• We will also ask which platform you would like the game on (Switch, PS5, PC, or Xbox)• If you purchased a tier with a Discord role, we will reach out and get your username 

Then in June, you can expect the early demo of the game before Steam Next Fest, the digital manga (vol 1) and shortly after that, everyone who purchased the vinyl will start seeing it in the mail around July, along with the digital artbook.  

As we get closer to launch, we will start to send out surveys and messages regarding the in-game features like the Feathered Obelisk and your in-game bird, if you are a backer of those tiers.  

The exclusive in-game skins will be delivered as redeemable codes around launch day next year. 

Then, backers can expect to see physical versions of the game after launch! 

It's going to be a fantastic year of constant Atomic Owl rewards coming your way. We can't wait for you all to get everything. ✨

[b]Now, how can you help support our studio after the Kickstarter?[/b]

Well...

Game Development, especially indie development, takes a lot of work and well, funds! Our goal with the Kickstarter was to get the game (and vinyl!) in as many people's hands as possible. We believe in the potential of Atomic Owl, and as indicated by our Kickstarter, so do you! 

We aimed for several stretch goals, and while we're committed to adding voice acting to the game, we also have other features we'd like to include before launch. To achieve this and build a community of supporters, we've decided to launch a completely optional Patreon. 

[url=http://www.patreon.com/monstertheater]Check it out here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841312/1dfffaa95333dd9bb3b420c135cf515cc97caa6c.png[/img]

• Welcome digital copy of the soundtrack
• Discord Role with exclusive benefits -- Winged Patron
• Your name in the game credits as a Patreon member!

Thank you for your support -- even if you are just an egg.

notes.title: Atomic Owl is officially coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
